versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-xhs-kol-evaluation-data.

- Provides structured retrieval of Xiaohongshu (RED) public content data: keyword search, post details, comment extraction, and creator post lists, up to 10,000 entries per request.
- Designed for scenarios where users need to collect content data for later analysis, comparison, or reporting.
- Covers four main outputs: note lists (search), single note details, comment data, and creator works collections.
- Only fetches public data, does not support publishing, interaction, or private content.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access; setup guidance included.
- Includes clear command examples, input requirements, and error handling guidance.
